# STATIC-mode inputs for the binding tests

The documents under `a2a/` and `supply-chain/` are generated by
`tests/generate_static_inputs.rs`. It serializes the engines' own typed values in
the form their `StaticAdapter` reads. `committed_static_inputs_match_the_generator`
fails when a document drifts.

The bundles `../bundles/static-a2a` and `../bundles/static-sc` hold the result and
evidence files that the **real CLI** wrote in static mode over these inputs, plus a
copy of the inputs under `inputs/`:

```bash
dare-agent-security validate a2a --scenario static-inputs/a2a/scenario.json \
  --mode static --evidence-dir static-inputs/a2a/evidence --output-dir <out>
dare-agent-security validate supply-chain --scenario static-inputs/supply-chain/scenario.json \
  --mode static --evidence-dir static-inputs/supply-chain/evidence --output-dir <out>
```

The other bundles are the CLI's simulated-mode output for `TOOL-LAB-001`,
`IDENTITY-LAB-001`, `MEMORY-LAB-001`, `RAG-LAB-001`, `MCP-AUTH-LAB-001`, `PI-LAB-001`,
`SUPPLY-LAB-001`, `A2A-LAB-001` and `multiturn-lab-001`, with the scenario file copied
to `inputs/scenario.json` where the engine needs it. `remote/` is the output of
`validate replay-capture` over `crates/dare-agent-security-cli/tests/fixtures/remote-replay/`.

`rt/` (Cycle 025) is the output of `validate runtime-telemetry` over five recorded
OTEL-LAB exports and the lab policy, with the policy copied to `inputs/policy.json`
(only the result and evidence files are kept):

```bash
L=crates/dare-runtime-telemetry/tests/fixtures/otel-lab
dare-agent-security validate runtime-telemetry \
  --traces $L/OTL-001/trace-0.json --traces $L/OTL-007/trace-0.json \
  --traces $L/OTL-014/trace-0.json --traces $L/OTL-018/trace-0.json \
  --traces $L/OTL-023/trace-0.json --policy $L/OTL-001/policy.json --output-dir <out>
```
